# Missing Anchor Handling

The absence of anchors in candidate facts leads to warnings and complete rejection of these candidates, which could result in loss of important relationships if not monitored. Over-reliance on the presence of anchors can lead to unaddressed missing connections in the normalization process.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/normalize.py`
